mapper.sql: SELECT pm.id as managementId, pm.process_instance_id, pm.process_definition_id, pm.business_id, pm.business_code, pm.business_key, pm.process_status, pm.start_time, pm.end_time, pm.business_name, pm.approve_status, pm.act_process_definition_id, pm.create_user_id as managementCreateUserId, ptm.id AS taskManagementId, ptm.cur_activity_id, ptm.task_id, ptm.cur_approve_id, ptm.cur_approve_name, ptm.task_status, ptm.timeout_status, ptm.timeout_warn_time, ptm.timeout_handle_type, ptm.timeout_handle_time, ptm.start_time AS taskStartTime, ptm.approve_time, ptm.approve_id, ptm.approve_name, ptm.remark, ptm.pre_activity_id, ptm.execution_id, ptm.cur_activity_name FROM process_management pm , process_task_management ptm where pm.process_instance_id = ptm.process_instance_id and pm.is_deleted = false and ptm.is_deleted = false

select * from ( SELECT ptm.id, pm.id as managementId, pm.process_instance_id, pm.process_definition_id, pm.process_version , pm.process_status , pm.process_name , pm.business_id , pm.business_code , pm.business_name , pm.business_key, pm.act_process_definition_id , ptm.cur_approve_id , ptm.cur_activity_id, ptm.cur_activity_name, ptm.task_id, ptm.task_status, ptm.cur_approve_name AS cur_approve_name, concat(wm.detail_url,pm.business_id) as detail_url, pm.create_time as createTime, pm.update_time as updateTime, ptm.label_json, ptm.approve_time, pm.end_time, 'erp' as sourcePlatform FROM process_task_management AS ptm LEFT JOIN process_management AS pm on pm.process_instance_id = ptm.process_instance_id AND pm.is_deleted = false LEFT JOIN work_menu AS wm on pm.business_key = wm.module_code AND wm.is_deleted = false LEFT JOIN process_definition pd on pd.id = pm.process_definition_id and pd.is_deleted = false where ptm.is_deleted = false union all select tptm.id, tpm.id as managementId, tpm.process_instance_id, tpm.process_definition_id, null as process_version , tpm.status as process_status , tpm.process_instance_name as process_name , tpm.business_id , tpm.business_code , '' as business_name , tpm.business_key, '' as act_process_definition_id , tptm.sys_user_id as cur_approve_id , tptm.node_id as cur_activity_id, tptm.node_name as cur_activity_name, tptm.task_id, tptm.task_status, '' AS cur_approve_name, '' as detail_url, tpm.create_time as createTime, tpm.update_time as updateTime, null as label_json, case when tptm.task_status = 'approve' then tptm.end_time else null end as approve_time, tpm.end_time, 'fs' as sourcePlatform from third_process_task_management tptm inner join third_process_management tpm on tptm.main_id = tpm.id and tpm.is_deleted = false where tptm.is_deleted = false ) pp where ${param.sqlMap.default} order by pp.createTime desc
mapper.select: AND approve_status = 'approveIng' AND pm.business_id = #{businessId} AND pm.business_key = #{businessKey} AND ptm.task_status = 'approveIng' ORDER BY ptm.create_time ASC

AND ptm.timeout_warn_time <= now()
AND ptm.timeout_handle_time <= now()
AND ptm.task_id = #{taskId}
AND ptm.timeout_status = #{timeoutStatus} AND ptm.task_status = 'approveIng' ORDER BY ptm.create_time ASC LIMIT 200

AND approve_status = 'approveIng'AND ptm.task_status = 'approveIng'
and ptm.id in
#{id}
ORDER BY ptm.create_time ASC

SELECT pm.process_instance_id, pm.business_id, pm.business_code, pm.business_key, pm.business_name, string_agg(ptm.cur_activity_id,',') AS activityId, string_agg(ptm.cur_activity_name,',') AS activityName, string_agg(ptm.cur_approve_id,',') AS curApproveId, string_agg(ptm.cur_approve_name,',') AS curApproveName FROM process_management pm LEFT JOIN process_task_management ptm ON pm.process_instance_id = ptm.process_instance_id AND ptm.is_deleted = false AND ptm.task_status = 'approveIng' WHERE pm.is_deleted = false AND (pm.business_id, pm.business_key) in
(#{item.businessId}, #{item.businessKey})
GROUP BY pm.business_id, pm.business_code, pm.business_key,pm.process_instance_id, pm.business_name

SELECT pm.process_instance_id, pm.business_id, pm.business_code, pm.business_key, pm.business_name, ptm.cur_activity_id AS activityId, ptm.cur_activity_name AS activityName, ptm.cur_approve_id AS curApproveId, ptm.cur_approve_name AS curApproveName FROM process_management pm LEFT JOIN process_task_management ptm ON pm.process_instance_id = ptm.process_instance_id AND ptm.is_deleted = false AND ptm.task_status = 'approveIng' WHERE pm.is_deleted = false AND (ptm.cur_approve_id, pm.business_key) in
(#{item.curApproveId}, #{item.businessKey})
